source_text: Timore dicit: soror mea est. Dominus benedicit Isaac; centuplum messis. Invidia Philistinorum.
pass_a_gloss: By-fear he-says: sister my she-is. Lord blesses Isaac; hundredfold harvest. Envy of-Philistines.
pass_b_english: In fear he says, [[She is my sister >> Bible:Genesis 26:7]]. The Lord blesses Isaac; [[a hundredfold harvest >> Bible:Genesis 26:12]]. Envy of the Philistines.
